The Pages view lists the type rows copied from development/index.html → Apps → Types; counts are computed on load. Each row shows the real extracted strings, grouped by texty level; tick rows for the export and edit a value in place — the text on the right and both downloads update as you go. The Fields row (Inside, Mating, Linguistics, Social, Economy) sits above the type chips as a parallel parent filter: no category is checked on load, every chip uses one standard border and a light wash of its exact category colour, and a checked chip takes that same colour at full strength while filtering any type — pages and projects can join it later. Only the type row keeps distinct borders. It has no title in the row and never nests the list below. Apps (formerly Standard) owns Backend, Demo and Launcher as subs; Skill owns sys, authoring, planning and utility. Type chips and the Skill/Apps subbuttons share distinct border/font designs; unchecked subs carry no colour, checked Apps subs take a stronger purple wash. Apps opens with no subs selected and the full Apps list visible; clicking Backend, Demo or Launcher hides every row outside that group, and clicking the same chip again restores the full list. The subchip counts are live: they follow the Fields filter and never drop to zero just because the chip is off. Rows stay flat in parent order — no extra subparent title rows — and each row carries its parent's border/font design plus its own field colour; rows are collapsed on load and their inputs hydrate only when opened. The field category chips and their child rows keep their premade colours — Cathy stays orange even when the Inside filter is off. Project keeps two thin dotted borders with a wider gap between them, at the same overall size. Presentation is the former Page type. The Dev view is orthogonal and follows the shared five-rung Data Depth ladder: Surface, Labels, Names, Data and Contracts. Depth 1 · Surface lists the workflow taxonomy families — sections, stages, synonyms, tasks, archive, states, evidence, impact, procedures and queue policy — exported from their canonical owners into one editable table; its plain text is the Dev pack. Deeper chips add canonical values, machine names, derived views and contracts; depth 3/4 tabs keep editable field tables and depth 5 keeps auditors with their reads/contract subs. Full → Refresh swaps in the selected page fields, Taxonomies restores the table, and Copy Dev pack exports the textarea without touching the Pages selection. The rows are embedded from their owners, so file:// works offline and each row keeps its canonical URL. A second row beside the prompt offers Vocabularies (every field name from milestones.json, common.json, the PROC fields, the schema ids and the §13.7 prefixes, each tagged with its owner) and Addons structure (the development/addons folder tree), both written into the prompt textarea.
